correctness.rationale: For every d,b,V>0, exact independent-failure multiplication gives an additive log-failure benefit. A strict series inequality and derivative identity show Q_d has exactly one zero in (0,d), with negative derivative there and negative sign afterward; the unique benefit-per-volume maximizer proves the universal bound and equality cases. Real-k unimodality proves the two-neighbor integer rule for equal fragments. The embedded program passed 43,789 supporting finite checks; they are not used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Protecting at least one copy of a donor genet is a natural, biologically distinct conservation objective from expected biomass. For a concrete edge-exposure survival law, the theorem establishes the sharp global reliability ceiling for every finite cutting pattern, exact attainability, one universal size scale across all tissue budgets, an efficient exact count rule when cuts are equal, and monotone geometry dependence. This is a useful analytic benchmark despite model limitations.
